blocks.title: Why Value Is Strongest in These Scenarios

Keep Local Product Intent—Add Choice Privileges: retain Econo Lodge's brand promise while accessing loyalty earn/redeem and parent commercial systems a standalone hotel cannot buy alone.
Hard economy: essential rooms and lowest-cost operations with Choice Privileges distribution for highly price-sensitive transient demand.
Sibling Clarity: diligence fit versus same-parent peers before assuming identical owner use case or fee path.
Operator & Owner Fit: strongest when the asset can deliver the brand's guest promise with QA discipline—weakest when sponsors want the flag without the product investment.
